stories.title: Tuinalogy C01-C05 Meridian Chart Image Placeholders and Captions
stories.description: Add markdown image syntax with anatomical landmarks and bilingual labels for meridian pathway illustrations in theory lessons across all CUs, supporting clinical accuracy and WIM readability standards.
acceptanceCriteria: All C01-C05 PM-teori.md files contain at least 2 meridian diagram placeholders with markdown syntax ![meridian](path) and Chinese/English captions including acupoint locations and anatomical landmarks
Meridian diagram captions include bilingual formatting (Simplified Chinese + English) with acupoint references (穴位) and pathway descriptions per WIM format MP-031-3:2016-C0X/meridian-(seq).png
Image placeholders follow WIM naming convention with alt-text and reference numbers, enabling future PDF export with proper figure numbering
technicalNotes: File to edit: tuinalogy-services/C01/PM-teori.md (insert markdown image blocks with alt-text and bilingual captions)
Test command: grep -r '!\[.*meridian' tuinalogy-services/*/PM-teori.md | wc -l (verify >= 10 placeholders across 7 CUs)

stories.title: Tuinalogy Pregnancy Contraindications (禁忌五穴) Safety Matrix
stories.description: Create comprehensive safety reference document mapping 5 forbidden acupoints during pregnancy (禁忌五穴) with clinical rationale, alternative techniques, assessment scenarios, and compliance with T&CM Act 2013 and MOH guidelines.
acceptanceCriteria: New document MP-031-3:2016-Safety/pregnancy-contraindications.md contains contraindicated acupoints table (穴位 | EN | Clinical Rationale | Alternative Technique), ≥3 KT-format exam questions on pregnancy screening, and citations to T&CM Act 2013 and MOH guidelines
KT documents in C01-C02 each integrated with ≥2 scenario-based pregnancy screening questions (MCQ or case analysis format) with full answer schemes in bilingual format
PA (Performance Assessment) rubrics updated to include pregnancy safety competency criterion with 4-point scale (Novice through Exemplary)
technicalNotes: File to create: tuinalogy-services/_reference/pregnancy-contraindications.md (markdown table with acupoint details, rationale, alternatives, plus scenario questions with bilingual answers)
Test command: grep -c '禁忌' tuinalogy-services/_reference/pregnancy-contraindications.md && grep -c 'pregnancy\|妊娠' tuinalogy-services/C0[12]/KT*.md

stories.title: Tuinalogy KT Enhanced Question Types with Simplified Chinese Answer Schemes
stories.description: Expand all KT (assignment sheet) documents with varied question formats (MCQ, matching, short-answer, case analysis) tagged with Bloom's cognitive levels and complete bilingual answer schemes; increase content depth 3x per CU.
acceptanceCriteria: All 7 CU KT documents (C01-C05, E01-E02) contain ≥3 distinct question types (MCQ, matching, short-answer, scenario-based) with each question tagged with Bloom's level (记忆/理解/应用/分析/评价) as markdown comment
Complete bilingual answer schemes provided: English model answer (150-200 words) + 简体中文 detailed explanation (150-200 words) for every question; documents expand from ~500 to ≥1500 words per CU
KT documents demonstrate varied cognitive levels across all 5-6 Bloom's stages per CU, avoiding >40% concentration at any single level
technicalNotes: File to edit: tuinalogy-services/C01/KT-01.md (add question type diversity, Bloom's level comments, bilingual answer schemes)
Test command: uv run python scripts/validate_ktt_bloom_tags.py tuinalogy-services/ --check-answer-schemes && echo 'Bloom diversity validated'

stories.title: Tuinalogy C03 Technique Illustration Step-by-Step Breakdown with Humanized Instructor Notes
stories.description: Enhance C03 KK (practical work sheets) with annotated technique diagrams, common student mistakes with corrections, scaffolded practice progressions, and instructor talking points for improved clinical accuracy and pedagogical clarity.
acceptanceCriteria: C03 KK-*.md documents include ≥4 technique illustrations (markdown ![technique](path)) with numbered step-by-step annotations and anatomical landmarks labeled in bilingual format (EN + 简体中文)

Each KK technique section contains: (1) 3-step Basic Progression, (2) ≥2 Common Mistakes with specific corrections, (3) Instructor Notes callout box (~100 words) identifying assessment checkpoints and common student misconceptions; documents increase from ~800 to ≥2000 words
KK documents cross-reference related KP theory sections (e.g., 'Review C03-KP-01 八纲 application before practicing this technique') for scaffolded learning progression
technicalNotes: File to edit: tuinalogy-services/C03/KK-01.md (add diagram placeholders, step-by-step annotations, Common Mistakes section, and > **Instructor Notes:** callout)
Test command: grep -c 'Instructor Notes\|Common Mistakes' tuinalogy-services/C03/KK*.md && wc -l tuinalogy-services/C03/KK-01.md

stories.title: IT-020 Lab Activity Hands-On Equipment Mapper
stories.description: Create CLI tool and reference documentation indexing IT-020 practical activities (KK documents) against required lab equipment, software versions, network configurations; generate per-CU equipment checklists and setup prerequisites for instructors.
acceptanceCriteria: New CLI script scripts/it020_lab_mapper.py reads IT-020 KK documents and outputs: (1) per-CU equipment manifest (CSV format with: equipment | part_number | quantity | estimated_cost), (2) software dependency matrix with version pinning (software | min_version | max_version | license_type), (3) network topology requirements (topology_desc | vlans | bandwidth_req | security_groups)
Reference doc _reference/it-020-lab-equipment.md lists ≥30 equipment items with model numbers, quantity per lab, estimated cost, and safety/certification ratings per OSHA standards
Script validates that every KK work activity (≥15 across L3/L4/L5) maps to ≥1 equipment item; generated checklists include time estimates per CU and prerequisite equipment setup order
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/it020_lab_mapper.py (argument parser, CSV generation from YAML/JSON config, validation logic)
Test command: uv run python scripts/it020_lab_mapper.py --output /tmp/it020_manifest.csv && head -20 /tmp/it020_manifest.csv && wc -l /tmp/it020_manifest.csv

stories.title: BEV Diagnostic Fault Code Scenario Randomizer
stories.description: Build CLI tool generating ≥50 unique fault code diagnosis scenarios for BEV KK practice by combining OBD-II codes, symptom clusters, root causes, and repair procedures; enable realistic case-based learning and assessment variety.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/bev_scenario_generator.py generates ≥50 unique fault code scenarios by combining: (1) OBD-II codes extracted from BEV NOSS (P0xxx, P1xxx, P3xxx ranges), (2) symptom clusters (loss of power, battery warning, thermal runaway), (3) root causes linked to CU content, (4) repair step references with CU cross-references

Each scenario includes: fault code, symptom description, expected diagnostics (tools/procedures), repair steps with CU reference (e.g., 'Refer to C02-KP-03 BMS Diagnostics'), and 3-5 assessment questions at Bloom's levels 3-4 (Application/Analysis)

Generated scenarios saved as markdown case studies compatible with KK format (MP-031-3:2016-Scenarios/fault_scenario_001.md); script supports filtering by CU, severity level (critical/major/minor), and tool requirements
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/bev_scenario_generator.py (OBD-II code data structure, symptom clustering, template-based scenario generation, question generation)
Test command: uv run python scripts/bev_scenario_generator.py --count 10 --output /tmp/ && ls /tmp/scenario_*.md | wc -l

stories.title: Tuinalogy T&CM Act 2013 Compliance Annotations
stories.description: Audit all Tuinalogy KP/KK/PA documents and add inline compliance citations referencing T&CM Act 2013 (licensing/registration), PDPA 2010 (client consent), OSHA 1994 (workplace safety), MOH Code of Ethics 2007; create compliance reference guide with CU mappings.
acceptanceCriteria: All KP/KK/PA documents contain ≥2 inline compliance citations as markdown footnotes: [^1] = 'T&CM Act 2013, Section X - Professional Registration' or [^2] = 'PDPA 2010 - Client Consent and Privacy'; total ≥14 footnotes across 7 CUs per document type

New reference doc tuinalogy-services/_reference/compliance-guide.md lists: (1) Licensing/registration requirements (T&CM Act 2013), (2) Client consent procedures (PDPA 2010), (3) Workplace safety requirements (OSHA 1994, accident reporting), (4) Professional ethics (MOH 2007, confidentiality, professional conduct) with applicable CU mappings and scenario examples

KT/KA documents include ≥2 scenario-based compliance questions (e.g., 'What PDPA requirement applies before collecting client medical history?') with full answer schemes; PA rubrics include compliance competency criterion (4-point scale from 'Novice' to 'Exemplary')
technicalNotes: File to create: tuinalogy-services/_reference/compliance-guide.md (markdown regulatory table with EN/BM/Simplified Chinese terminology, CU mapping, and scenario examples)
Test command: grep -r '\[\^[0-9]\]' tuinalogy-services/C*/KP*.md | wc -l (verify >= 14 footnotes)

stories.title: Assessment Question Time-Box Validator with Cognitive Load Scorer
stories.description: Build CLI tool analyzing KT/KA questions for estimated completion time using readability metrics, complexity scoring, and Bloom's levels; flag questions exceeding time budgets per question type; integrate with CI/CD for quality gates.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/question_timebox_validator.py analyzes KT/KA markdown extracting all questions and calculating: (1) completion time using Flesch-Kincaid + question structure heuristics, (2) complexity score (word count, nested conditions, multi-part indicators), (3) Bloom's cognitive level (via keyword matching or inline comments); outputs report with columns: question_id | question_type | word_count | estimated_time_min | Bloom_level | status (OK/SLOW/COMPLEX)
Validation thresholds configurable per question type: MCQ ≤5min, matching ≤8min, short-answer ≤15min, scenario-based ≤20min; report flags questions exceeding thresholds and suggests splits/rewording
CI/CD integration: script fails if >20% of questions exceed time budgets (configurable threshold), enabling enforcement of assessment fairness standards
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/question_timebox_validator.py (regex-based question extraction, Flesch-Kincaid readability calc, Bloom's detection, threshold comparison, report generation)
Test command: uv run python scripts/question_timebox_validator.py tuinalogy-services/C01/KT-01.md --output /tmp/timebox_report.txt && grep -c SLOW /tmp/timebox_report.txt

stories.title: Tuinalogy ARCS Motivation Elements Audit and Enhancement
stories.description: Audit all Tuinalogy KP/KK/PM documents against ARCS motivation model (Attention/Relevance/Confidence/Satisfaction); enhance weak areas with clinical vignettes, case studies, reflection prompts, and confidence-building scaffolds; generate gap analysis report.
acceptanceCriteria: New script scripts/arcs_audit.py scans KP/KK/PM documents and categorizes content against ARCS dimensions; generates per-CU report identifying gaps (e.g., 'C02 KP lacks Satisfaction closure; recommend adding reflection prompt')

Each KP/KK document enhanced with: (1) Attention hook (opening clinical vignette or compelling question, ≥50 words), (2) Relevance callout (Why this technique matters clinically, ≥80 words with patient outcomes), (3) Confidence builder (scaffolded practice progression, 'Did you know?' tips), (4) Satisfaction closure (reflection prompt inviting metacognition or success celebration statement)

PM-teori.md documents include ≥1 clinical vignette per CU (~200 words) demonstrating technique application in realistic patient scenarios; KK documents include ≥1 reflection prompt callout prompting clinical reasoning
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/arcs_audit.py (content pattern matching for ARCS dimensions, gap identification, report generation with recommendations)
Test command: grep -c 'Clinical vignette:\|Reflection:' tuinalogy-services/C01/PM-teori.md && uv run python scripts/arcs_audit.py tuinalogy-services/C01/ --output /tmp/arcs_report.md

stories.title: Tuinalogy C01-C02 TCM Foundation Theory Callout Boxes and Mnemonic Aids
stories.description: Enhance readability of foundational TCM concepts (八纲 Eight Principles / 四诊 Four Diagnostics / 经络 Meridians) in C01-C02 KP documents with highlighted callout boxes, visual mnemonic acronyms, and digestible theory summaries; create TCM glossary.
acceptanceCriteria: All C01-C02 KP documents reorganized with structured sections per key concept: (1) Key Concept Callout box (> **Key Concept:** with ≥100 words explanation), (2) Visual Summary (markdown table or diagram reference), (3) Mnemonic Aid (memory trick, e.g., '八纲 = Yin/Yang + Cold/Heat + Excess/Deficiency + Interior/Exterior = 8 Principles'), (4) Clinical Bridge (how concept applies to technique selection)

Markdown callout syntax implemented (> **Key Concept:** or > ⭐ **Remember:**); new _reference/tcm-foundation-glossary.md contains ≥15 bilingual term triplets (简体中文 | English | 馬來文): 八纲, 四诊, 经络, 穴位, 气血, 阴阳, 虚实
C01-C02 KP documents expand from ~500 to ≥1200 words per document, with ≥2 callout boxes per KP containing mnemonic aids and clinical applications
technicalNotes: File to edit: tuinalogy-services/C01/KP-01.md (restructure with callout syntax, mnemonic boxes, clinical bridges; create _reference/tcm-foundation-glossary.md with bilingual triplets)
Test command: grep -c '> \*\*' tuinalogy-services/C0[12]/KP*.md | awk '{s+=$NF} END {print s}' (verify >= 4 callout boxes)

stories.title: Aesthetic Services Knowledge Assessment Item Analysis Report Generator
stories.description: Build Python script analyzing KA (Knowledge Assessment) question distributions across Aesthetic CUs; identify difficulty/Bloom's level imbalances, suggest rebalancing, and validate question-to-competency mappings for comprehensive coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/aesthetic_kaa_analyzer.py parses all KA documents (C01-C04 per level): (1) extracts questions, (2) tags each with Bloom's level (via content keywords or metadata comments), (3) calculates difficulty distribution (word count, sentence complexity), (4) maps to CoCU competencies (via question ID or manual tagging in markdown comments), (5) generates report with columns: competency_id | num_questions | Bloom_distribution | difficulty_range | coverage_status

Report identifies coverage gaps: underrepresented competencies (<2 questions), Bloom's level skew (e.g., >50% at Remember level), missing question-competency mappings; includes rebalancing suggestions (e.g., 'C02 needs +2 Analyze-level questions; recommend splitting 2 current Knowledge questions into 3 Application questions')
Multiple output formats: markdown report for human review, CSV for instructor tracking, JSON for programmatic use; script integrates with CI/CD to flag coverage gaps
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/aesthetic_kaa_analyzer.py (markdown parsing, Bloom's tagging via heuristics, competency extraction, distribution analysis, report generation; JSON output for tooling)
Test command: uv run python scripts/aesthetic_kaa_analyzer.py aesthetic-services/ --output /tmp/kaa_report.md && grep -c 'Coverage status\|Rebalancing' /tmp/kaa_report.md

All IT-020 documents (L3/L4/L5 across C01-C05) updated to use preferred terminology with 100% consistency verified by script; assessment documents (KT/KA) include glossary footnotes for technical terms on first use
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/it020_terminology_auditor.py (regex-based term detection, consistency checking, suggestion logic; JSON/CSV output)

stories.title: Tuinalogy Performance Assessment Rubric with Video Reference Anchor Points
stories.description: Create comprehensive PA (Performance Assessment) documents for C01-C05 with detailed 4-point competency rubrics, performance indicators, and video timestamp anchors for consistent technique grading; include inter-rater reliability guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: PA documents for C01-C05 each contain: (1) rubric table with 4-point scale (Novice/Developing/Proficient/Exemplary) for ≥5 competencies per CU (e.g., 'Acupoint Identification Accuracy', 'Pressure Application Consistency', 'Client Communication', 'Safety Protocol Adherence', 'Tissue Palpation Sensitivity'), (2) performance indicators per competency level with specific, observable criteria (e.g., Novice = 'Cannot locate acupoint without reference'; Exemplary = 'Locates acupoint with ±5mm accuracy')

New reference doc tuinalogy-services/_reference/pa-video-anchors.md maps each PA competency to video segment: competency_id | video_url | timestamp_start-end | technique_name | exemplary_indicator (e.g., 'C03-Comp-1 | https://...tuinalogy-c03.mp4 | 2:35-3:10 | Three-Finger Push Technique | Student applies even pressure throughout; wrist maintains neutral position')

PA scoring template includes evidence collection space (e.g., 'Acupoint location correct - compare to 2:45 video exemplar'); inter-rater reliability guide provided with ≥3 sample student performance descriptions (Novice/Proficient/Exemplary) per competency (~100 words each) to enable consistent instructor grading
technicalNotes: File to create: tuinalogy-services/C01/PA.md (4-point rubric table structure, performance indicators per level, video anchor references)
Test command: grep -c 'Novice\|Exemplary\|Proficient' tuinalogy-services/C0[12345]/PA.md | awk '{s+=$NF} END {print s}' (verify >= 5 per CU)

stories.title: WIM Document Readability Enhancement Batch Tool with Flesch-Kincaid Scoring
stories.description: Develop batch processor scanning all .md WIM files across subjects (BEV, Aesthetic, IT, Tuinalogy); calculate readability scores (Flesch-Kincaid grade levels); identify overly complex paragraphs; suggest simplified alternatives while preserving technical accuracy.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/readability_analyzer.py analyzes all KP/KK/KT documents: (1) calculates Flesch-Kincaid grade level per paragraph, (2) flags paragraphs >grade 14 as 'Too Complex' with context, (3) generates ≥1 alternative rewordings preserving meaning and technical accuracy, (4) produces per-CU and per-subject readability report with summary metrics

Tool respects domain-specific complexity exceptions (e.g., allows higher grade levels for HV system technical descriptions if justified; includes flag explaining exception); baseline readability targets: KP ≤11th grade, KK ≤10th grade, KT ≤9th grade (configurable via CLI flag)

CI/CD integration: script generates warning (non-blocking) if >30% of paragraphs exceed target grade level; outputs markdown report with flagged paragraphs, alternative wordings, and overall readability metrics per subject; supports CSV export for tracking improvement over time
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/readability_analyzer.py (Flesch-Kincaid grade calculation, paragraph parsing, alternative generation with semantic preservation, report generation)
Test command: uv run python scripts/readability_analyzer.py bev-diagnostic-rectification/C01/KP-01.md --target-grade 11 --output /tmp/readability_report.md && head -30 /tmp/readability_report.md
